checkpoints.description: [1/6] Scaffold: Card model, crash-safe JSON deck store, add/list commands and CLI with failing-first unit tests, README, pyproject, LICENSE, ADR-001

impact_assessment.why: The kit has no spaced-repetition project: learning is a daily developer activity and every existing SRS tool either syncs to a cloud or drags in dependencies, so a local-first, stdlib-only SM-2 flashcard CLI fills the gap
impact_assessment.benefits: deterministic SM-2 scheduling as pure functions is fully unit-testable; one readable JSON deck file with atomic writes, backup and locking keeps the study state crash-safe; add/list/study/stats give a complete daily loop with zero setup and a sub-10-second demo
impact_assessment.risks: contract: deck schema {version, cards, reviews} is fixed at version 1 so later fields need migration; dependency: none beyond the standard library; concurrency: two mnemo processes mutate one deck file; state: a corrupt deck file must never lose cards
impact_assessment.mitigation: schema version checked on read and unknown versions refused in place; the store mirrors tally's proven atomic path (temp + fsync + os.replace, .bak, 3s/30s advisory lock, quarantine); scheduling is pure and clock-injected so tests pin dates exactly
